reviewNotes: Held back: the score has bars of another length (bar 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 001123 (the melody read from 001123a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. David Read has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1785, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001123a.nwc).
